usage: American family lifestyle illustrations in matching product galleries; not approved label images.

images.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural / compositing.
Create one finished premium editorial lifestyle photograph for the Chia Crunch Sticks product gallery of Organiya. PORTRAIT 4:5 aspect ratio, 1200 x 1500 composition, full bleed with no borders, no blank bands.
Input image 1 is the supplied Spicenza Chia Crunch Sticks pouch artwork, a product identity reference. Preserve its cream matte stand-up pouch shape, dark green Spicenza wordmark with leaf, green "Chia" and brown "Crunch Sticks" typography and botanical accents. Do not redesign or rename the pouch.
Scene: a believable, inviting American family game-night in a contemporary US home, four family members spanning two generations enjoying a relaxed conversation around an oak kitchen table. Candid gestures and warm natural expressions, everyday casual clothing, subtle board-game pieces without any readable game branding. American snack-table accompaniments: small veggie sliders, apple wedges and lemonade, kept secondary to the crunchy snack.
Composition: sharp, appetizing foreground hero of a ceramic bowl containing the actual type of chia snack depicted on the reference pouch: irregular short golden ridged sticks with visible dark seed flecks, NOT smooth breadsticks. The Spicenza pouch stands just behind and beside that bowl, front-facing enough that "Spicenza" and "Chia Crunch Sticks" are clearly readable and correctly spelled. It is realistically sized, roughly 20cm tall, not giant. The bowl and a naturally folded napkin obscure the lower front label below the product name, so no nutrition numbers, ingredient claims, net-weight line or certification marks are readable. Do not invent, change or inventively redraw those claims. Keep the recognizable upper pouch design accurate.
Family occupies the upper half of the portrait, natural American home details softly out of focus, with both family and branded pouch easily identifiable. Warm afternoon window light, cream, sage, wood and honey tones compatible with Organiya Option O. Real textures, nuanced depth, tasteful food advertising quality, no artificial plastic skin, no duplicated people, no distorted hands, no text overlays, no watermarks, no flags, no promotional badges. Family and food should look spontaneous, not a stock-photo lineup.

Use case: photorealistic-natural / compositing.
Create one finished premium editorial lifestyle photograph for the Veggie Crisps product gallery of Organiya. PORTRAIT 4:5 aspect ratio, 1200 x 1500 composition, full bleed with no borders or blank bars.
Input image 1 is the supplied Spicenza Veggie Crisps pouch artwork, a product identity reference. Preserve its cream matte resealable stand-up pouch, dark green Spicenza leaf wordmark, large green "Veggie", brown "Crisps", and beetroot/carrot/spinach botanical accents. Do not redesign or rename the pouch.
Scene: a relaxed multigenerational American family weekend cookout at a wooden backyard picnic table, four people in casual summer clothing sharing a conversation and snack plates; a recognizable comfortable suburban American garden and deck in the softly blurred background. American food pairings include grilled corn, small veggie sliders, avocado dip and a pitcher of lemonade. No alcohol and no flags.
Composition: the foreground features a bowl of the actual ridged vegetable crisps depicted on the reference pouch: chunky rectangular crinkle-cut pieces in muted beet red, carrot orange and leafy green, with textured seeded surfaces, NOT round potato chips. Place one realistically sized Spicenza Veggie Crisps pouch upright directly behind the bowl; upper brand and product name face the camera and remain correctly spelled and recognizable. The foreground bowl and another small serving plate naturally hide the lower label below the name, including nutrition/vegan claims, net weight and website. Do not invent new label claims or retype the small label copy. Pouch should look integrated into the table with correct perspective, soft contact shadows and natural material folds, not pasted on.
Frame family interaction in the upper half and product/food in the lower half, all fully integrated into a 4:5 portrait photograph. Warm late afternoon sunlight with gentle tree shade, inviting cream, forest-green and golden tones, high-end food editorial realism, believable hands, candid smiles, visible delicious textures. No added captions, no watermarks, no certifications, no promotional slogans.
